name: QUT International Talent Scholarship
summary: Automatic 20% tuition reduction every semester for high-achieving new international students at QUT.
key: You'll receive an ongoing scholarship to cover 20% of your tuition fees per semester of study at QUT.
who: New international student with an offer for an eligible course and an eligible nationality.
Meets the minimum academic standard for your qualification, such as an ATAR of 80.00.
Can't hold another QUT academic scholarship.
how: You don't need to apply. The offer comes with your admission letter.
catches: Continues only while you meet your course conditions.

evidence.quote: You'll receive an ongoing scholarship to cover 20% of your tuition fees per semester of study at QUT.
You don't need to apply for this scholarship.
